title: Το σύμπαν και τα αστέρια
description: Ten standalone stories, essays and an interview about the night sky, the stars and the people who watch them, from observatories and the northern lights to a village star calendar.

lessons.title: Μια νύχτα στο αστεροσκοπείο
lessons.summary: A diary of one night spent helping an astronomer cousin at a mountain observatory, from dusk to dawn.

lessons.title: Ο Νεύτωνας και τα χρόνια της πανούκλας
lessons.summary: A profile of Isaac Newton: his early birth, the two plague years at home, gravity, inertia and his empty lecture hall.

lessons.title: Ο ήλιος στην αυλή του σχολείου
lessons.summary: A primary school teacher builds a scale model of the solar system in the schoolyard with her pupils and the PE teacher.

lessons.title: Κάτω από το πολικό σέλας
lessons.summary: A couple travels to northern Norway, sails along the coast and finally sees the northern lights.

lessons.title: Ρουκέτες, λεφτά και άστρα
lessons.summary: An opinion column weighs whether a country in fiscal trouble should spend money on space, from water rockets to private companies and dynamite.

lessons.title: Ο παππούς μου και ο κομήτης
lessons.summary: A grandson retells how his grandfather, a young assistant at a mountain weather station, left the instrument room to watch a comet and told his chief the truth.

lessons.title: Φτιαγμένοι από αστέρια
lessons.summary: A reflective essay on how the elements of our bodies were forged in stars and how that makes all people relatives.

lessons.title: Ένα σαββατοκύριακο στο Πήλιο
lessons.summary: A busy Athenian lawyer spends a spring weekend at a mountain guesthouse, meditating under the stars instead of watching series.

lessons.title: Όταν βασιλεύει η Πούλια
lessons.summary: A granddaughter visits her grandfather in a Thessalian village as he cleans his seed and sows wheat by an old star calendar.

lessons.title: Το αλφάβητο του ουρανού
lessons.summary: An interview with a lighting architect about light pollution, what she learned in Arizona and how cities can give back the night sky.
